tasks.DetermineSlopeFromIntercepts: Use the intercepts to determine the slope (m) of the line.
tasks.FindXIntercept: Calculate the x-intercept of the line given by the equation \(\frac{x}{4} + \frac{y}{12} = 1\).
tasks.FindYIntercept: Calculate the y-intercept of the line given by the equation \(\frac{x}{4} + \frac{y}{12} = 1\).
tasks.SumValues: Compute the sum of x-intercept, y-intercept, and slope.
